Eagles vs Bears DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, September 28 · NFL Week 3 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of September 28, 10:36 AM ET

Jalen Hurts carries the highest SPAGS model projection in Monday Night Football's Eagles at Bears DraftKings Showdown slate: 18.6 DraftKings points at a $10,800 FLEX salary, or 27.9 at captain for $16,200. Hurts holds the largest share of simulated winning-lineup credit at 72% across 100,000 simulations, including the largest captain share at 16.4%.

Behind Hurts, the next four projections are DeVonta Smith (16.8, $10,600), Saquon Barkley (16.0, $10,000), Case Keenum (13.8, $8,400) and D'Andre Swift (13.8, $9,600). Philadelphia is a 4.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 41.5, with implied team totals of 18.5 for the Bears and 23 for the Eagles.

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the September 28, 10:36 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Jalen Hurts, PHI QB ($10,800 FLEX / $16,200 CPT)

Jalen Hurts holds 16.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $16,200 and the 18.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 5.6 rushing attempts. The current projection of 18.6 compares with a saved model baseline of 17.8. Across 100,000 simulations Hurts averaged 18.5 points with a simulated floor of 7.2 and a ceiling of 33.7. He holds 72% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.4% as the captain and 56.0% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Saquon Barkley, PHI RB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Saquon Barkley holds 14.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 16.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 24.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 17.5 carries and 2.1 targets. The current projection of 16.0 compares with a saved model baseline of 10.3. Across 100,000 simulations Barkley averaged 15.9 points with a simulated floor of 5.9 and a ceiling of 30.6. He holds 57% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.3% as the captain and 42.4% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: DeVonta Smith, PHI WR ($10,600 FLEX / $15,900 CPT)

DeVonta Smith holds 13.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,900 and the 16.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 9.0 targets on 31.0 routes. The current projection of 16.8 compares with a saved model baseline of 13.8. Across 100,000 simulations Smith averaged 16.7 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 33.3. He holds 57% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.3% as the captain and 43.9% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Eagles vs Bears

Case Keenum, CHI QB ($8,400 FLEX / $12,600 CPT)

Case Keenum carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 13.8 DraftKings points for an $8,400 FLEX salary ($12,600 at captain). The model includes 4.6 rushing attempts. The current projection of 13.8 compares with a saved model baseline of 0.0. Across 100,000 simulations Keenum averaged 13.8 points with a simulated floor of 5.4 and a ceiling of 25.2. He holds 53% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.6% as the captain and 47.9% in a FLEX spot.

D'Andre Swift carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 13.8 DraftKings points for a $9,600 FLEX salary ($14,400 at captain). The model gives him 14.3 carries and 2.9 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Swift averaged 13.7 points with a simulated floor of 5.2 and a ceiling of 26.8. He holds 46% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 8.3% as the captain and 38.1% in a FLEX spot.

Luther Burden III, CHI WR ($7,600 FLEX / $11,400 CPT)

Luther Burden III carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 9.7 DraftKings points for a $7,600 FLEX salary ($11,400 at captain). The model gives him 6.1 targets on 24.4 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Burden averaged 9.7 points with a simulated floor of 1.7 and a ceiling of 25.0. He holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.3% as the captain and 21.9% in a FLEX spot.

Rome Odunze, CHI WR ($7,400 FLEX / $11,100 CPT)

Rome Odunze carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 9.6 DraftKings points for a $7,400 FLEX salary ($11,100 at captain). The model gives him 7.2 targets on 30.1 routes. The current projection of 9.6 compares with a saved model baseline of 7.4. Across 100,000 simulations Odunze averaged 9.6 points with a simulated floor of 1.6 and a ceiling of 24.1. He holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.0% as the captain and 21.6% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Dontayvion Wicks, PHI WR ($4,400 FLEX / $6,600 CPT)

Dontayvion Wicks projects for 9.6 DraftKings points at a $4,400 FLEX salary, 2.18 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 5.5 targets on 24.7 routes. The current projection of 9.6 compares with a saved model baseline of 7.5. Across 100,000 simulations Wicks averaged 9.6 points with a simulated floor of 1.7 and a ceiling of 24.0. He holds 34% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.5% as the captain and 28.7% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Kalif Raymond, CHI WR ($3,800 FLEX / $5,700 CPT)

Kalif Raymond projects for 8.0 DraftKings points at a $3,800 FLEX salary, 2.09 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 5.0 targets on 25.0 routes. The current projection of 8.0 compares with a saved model baseline of 9.7. Across 100,000 simulations Raymond averaged 7.9 points with a simulated floor of 0.4 and a ceiling of 21.4. He holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.0% as the captain and 22.9% in a FLEX spot.
